title: Reproductive Rights and Abortion Access
question_text: How should the law handle abortion?

stances.text: keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit.
keep abortion legal through the second trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health.
allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health.
ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life.
ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions.

title: Artificial Intelligence Oversight
question_text: How much should government oversee artificial intelligence development and deployment?

stances.text: Allow AI companies to develop and deploy technology freely without government interference
Suggest AI safety guidelines but let companies choose whether to follow them
Hold AI developers legally responsible when their systems cause harm
Require safety testing before AI can be used in high-stakes areas like hiring, healthcare, and policing
Impose strict government approval requirements before any AI system can be deployed

title: Campaign Finance Reform
question_text: What rules should govern money in political campaigns and elections?

stances.text: Ban all private money in political campaigns
Strictly limit corporate and dark-money spending
Keep contribution limits at current levels
Reduce restrictions on political donations and spending
Eliminate all campaign finance laws and limits

title: Childcare Affordability & Access
question_text: How should government address the cost and availability of childcare?

stances.text: Establishing publicly funded universal childcare so that all families have access regardless of income
Significantly expanding subsidies and provider grants to make childcare affordable for low- and middle-income families
Offering targeted tax credits and subsidies for families below a set income threshold while supporting providers through training and facility grants
Limiting government support to childcare subsidies for the lowest-income families, relying on the private market for everyone else
Leaving childcare to the private market and families, with no government subsidies or mandates that increase costs for providers and taxpayers

title: City Sanitation and Cleanliness
question_text: How should your community approach street cleanliness and sanitation?

stances.text: Significantly expand public sanitation services, treating cleanliness as the city's responsibility
Concentrate sanitation resources on the most neglected, worst-served neighborhoods to close long-standing service gaps
Maintain current public sanitation services and target enforcement at the businesses and large property owners who create the most waste
Rely primarily on enforcement of anti-littering and property maintenance laws; hold residents and businesses responsible
Privatize sanitation services and require residents and businesses to contract for cleanup directly

title: Civil Rights and Social Justice
question_text: What role should government play in addressing racial and social inequality?

stances.text: mandate racial equity requirements in all institutions
strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination
maintain current civil rights laws while promoting equal opportunity
limit federal civil rights enforcement to clear cases of discrimination
eliminate affirmative action and all race-based government programs

title: Data Center Development & Energy Costs
question_text: How should government manage the growth of large-scale data centers?

stances.text: Imposing a moratorium on new data center construction until energy infrastructure can support demand without raising costs for residential ratepayers
Barring utilities from passing any data center energy infrastructure costs to residential customers
Allowing data center development with impact assessments, energy cost-sharing agreements, and community benefit requirements before approval
Encouraging data center development through streamlined permitting while requiring transparency about projected energy demand and rate impacts
Welcoming data center investment with minimal regulatory barriers, trusting that economic growth and tax revenue will benefit all residents

title: Fossil Fuel Policy
question_text: What role should fossil fuels play in the nation's energy future?

stances.text: Phase out fossil fuel production entirely.
Allow no new drilling and let production decline over time.
Keep fossil fuel production steady at current levels.
Expand fossil fuel production with new drilling and permits.
Maximize production and open more public land and waters to drilling.

title: Healthcare Access
question_text: What role should government play in healthcare access?

stances.text: Make healthcare free and available to everyone, fully paid for by the public sector
Make sure everyone has affordable coverage through a mix of public programs and regulated private insurance
Help people who can't afford care and expand programs for seniors and low-income residents, while keeping private insurance for everyone else
Only help the poorest people afford healthcare and leave everyone else to employers and private insurance
Stay out of healthcare entirely and let private markets handle all coverage decisions

title: Jail Capacity and Incarceration Alternatives
question_text: How should government respond to jail overcrowding and criminal justice demand?

stances.text: Redirecting incarceration funding into community-based mental health, addiction, housing, and restorative justice programs to shrink the jail system
Reducing the incarcerated population through alternatives to incarceration rather than building new capacity
Upgrading jail facilities only as needed to meet constitutional standards, without expanding overall capacity
Building additional jail capacity to address overcrowding and facility deficiencies
Expanding jail capacity as the primary response to crime, prioritizing detention over alternatives

title: Medicare / Medicaid
question_text: How should Medicare and Medicaid be funded and structured?

stances.text: expand Medicare to cover everyone regardless of age
significantly expand Medicare or Medicaid eligibility, stopping short of universal coverage
improve current programs while controlling costs
scale back both programs, shifting more coverage to private insurance
phase out both programs and use private insurance only

title: Online Misinformation and Content Moderation
question_text: What responsibility do platforms and government have in combating online misinformation?

stances.text: legally require platforms to remove false information
require platforms to label false content, rather than remove it
encourage voluntary standards for combating misinformation online
protect free speech online and prevent government censorship
ban any government involvement in content moderation decisions

title: State Redistricting and Gerrymandering
question_text: Who should draw electoral district boundaries and how should they be determined?

stances.text: independent citizens' commissions with no elected officials involved at any level.
independent redistricting commissions with equal representation from both major parties.
bipartisan legislative committees with strict rules requiring supermajority approval.
state legislatures with court oversight to prevent extreme partisan bias.
the party that controls the state legislature without outside interference.

title: Religious Freedom
question_text: How should the law balance religious freedom with protection from discrimination?

stances.text: prohibit religious exemptions from civil rights and anti-discrimination laws.
protect religious freedom while ensuring it doesn't override anti-discrimination protections in employment and housing.
balance protecting religious practices with maintaining equal treatment under the law for all citizens.
protect religious freedom and allow faith-based exemptions from laws that conflict with sincere religious beliefs.
strongly protect religious freedom and allow religious organizations complete autonomy in their operations and hiring practices.

title: Same-Sex Marriage
question_text: What legal recognition should same-sex marriages receive?

stances.text: Guarantee same-sex couples full legal equality — equal marriage plus protection from discrimination (such as in jobs and housing).
Guarantee same-sex marriage the same benefits and protections as any other marriage.
Allow same-sex marriage, but protect religious organizations' right to decline to perform or host these marriages.
Recognize civil unions for same-sex couples, but reserve marriage for opposite-sex couples.
Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman.

title: School Vouchers & Public Education Funding
question_text: What role should vouchers and school choice play in the public education system?

stances.text: Eliminating voucher programs that divert taxpayer money from public schools to private institutions
Opposing voucher programs and blocking their expansion, without moving to eliminate existing ones
Allowing income-based voucher programs, open to a wider range of families under an income cap
Expanding voucher eligibility to most families so parents can choose the school that best fits their child
Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family

title: Social Security
question_text: How should Social Security be funded and structured for the future?

stances.text: expand Social Security benefits significantly and remove the income cap on payroll taxes to fund it.
increase Social Security benefits modestly while raising taxes on higher earners to strengthen the program.
make small adjustments to both benefits and taxes to keep Social Security stable for future generations.
gradually reduce future benefits rather than raise taxes to keep Social Security solvent.
transition Social Security to private investment accounts that individuals control themselves.

title: United States Tariff Policy
question_text: How should trade policy balance domestic industry with global commerce?

stances.text: eliminate all tariffs and pursue completely free trade with every country.
reduce most tariffs, keeping only limited exceptions.
use tariffs selectively to protect key American industries and jobs.
increase tariffs on countries that don't trade fairly with America.
impose high tariffs on all imports to bring manufacturing back to America.

title: Transgender Athletes
question_text: How should sports leagues determine eligibility for transgender athletes?

stances.text: allow all transgender athletes to compete on teams matching their gender identity without any restrictions or requirements.
should allow transgender athletes to compete on teams matching their gender identity after completing basic documentation of their transition.
decide transgender athletes' eligibility case by case based on individual circumstances and the requirements of each sport.
require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth.
completely ban all transgender athletes from competing in any organized sports competitions.

title: Ukraine - Russia Conflict
question_text: What level of military and financial support should be provided to Ukraine?

stances.text: significantly increase military and financial aid to Ukraine.
continue providing current levels of military and economic aid to help Ukraine defend itself.
provide limited humanitarian aid to Ukraine while encouraging diplomatic negotiations to end the war.
reduce aid to Ukraine and focus American resources on domestic priorities instead.
end all aid to Ukraine immediately and stay completely out of the conflict.

title: Voting Rights and Electoral Integrity
question_text: How should the government verify a voter's identity and eligibility?

stances.text: Require no identification to vote, verifying voters by signature or existing records.
Accept non-photo identification, such as a utility bill or bank statement.
Require photo ID to vote, but let voters without one cast a ballot after signing an affidavit.
Require photo ID in person and an ID number on every mail ballot.
Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.

title: 2020 Presidential Election
question_text: What is your view of the outcome of the 2020 presidential election?

stances.text: The election was fair and Joe Biden won legitimately.
Joe Biden won, but the election had real problems worth fixing.
There was some fraud, but not enough to change the result.
Fraud or irregularities may have been enough to change the result.
The election was stolen from Donald Trump through widespread fraud.

title: Border Security
question_text: How should the government handle people who cross the border?

stances.text: Give everyone who crosses the border a fair asylum hearing.
Expand orderly, legal ways to seek asylum at the border.
Combine strong enforcement with a faster asylum process.
Sharply restrict who can claim asylum at the border.
End asylum and quickly turn back anyone who crosses illegally.

title: Curriculum and Contested Topics
question_text: How should schools handle contested topics like race, gender, and history in what they teach?

stances.text: Require lessons that center race, gender, and social justice as themes across the curriculum
Teach an honest account of racism, injustice, and diverse identities as part of the core curriculum
Present contested social and historical topics as open questions, giving competing viewpoints equal weight
Keep the curriculum focused on core academics and leave contested social topics to families

title: School Library Books and Instructional Materials
question_text: How should schools handle challenges to books in libraries and classrooms?

stances.text: Keep every book available and let professional librarians and educators curate the collection
Keep challenged books available to all, while letting parents limit what their own child can borrow
Remove a challenged book only if a review committee of educators and parents finds it unsuitable

title: Parental Notification and Transgender Students
question_text: What should schools do when a student uses a different name or gender identity at school than at home?

stances.text: Use the student's chosen name and pronouns, and keep their gender identity from parents unless the student agrees to share it
Use the student's chosen name and pronouns, and tell parents only if they directly ask
Tell parents when a student changes their name or gender at school, unless staff believe it would put the student in danger

title: Equity and Inclusion Programs in Schools
question_text: How should schools address gaps in achievement and opportunity between groups of students?

stances.text: Fund dedicated equity offices and staff to close gaps between student groups

stances.text: Remove police officers from schools and rely on counselors and mental health staff
Keep officers out of schools and call them only when a serious crime occurs
Bring in a shared or part-time officer with a limited, clearly defined role
Place a dedicated officer in every school for safety, but bar them from routine discipline

title: Charter Schools
question_text: How should the board handle charter schools that want to open in the district?

stances.text: Stop authorizing new charter schools and move to close existing ones
Approve new charters rarely, only when a school is clearly failing students
Judge each charter application on its own merits
Welcome charters and approve strong applications to expand family options

title: School Budget and Spending Priorities
question_text: How should schools set spending levels and decide whether to raise more revenue?

stances.text: Raise taxes to significantly increase school funding
Increase funding modestly to keep pace with costs, without raising taxes
Hold funding flat at current levels

title: Artificial Intelligence in Schools
question_text: What role should artificial intelligence play in classrooms and student work?

stances.text: Prohibit artificial intelligence tools in student work and classroom instruction

title: Cannabis Policy
question_text: How should the government regulate cannabis?

stances.text: Keep cannabis fully illegal and enforce criminal penalties for possessing or selling it.
Allow cannabis only for medical use, available to patients with a physician's authorization.
Remove criminal penalties for personal possession, replacing them with civil fines, but keep commercial sales illegal.
Legalize recreational cannabis and regulate it through a licensed, taxed commercial market.
Legalize cannabis and treat it like an ordinary legal product, with minimal restrictions on growing and using it.

title: Defense Spending
question_text: How much should the government spend on the military?

stances.text: Increase military spending substantially, launching a major buildup to expand the armed forces and their capabilities.
Increase military spending moderately, growing the budget above inflation to keep pace with rising threats.
Hold military spending roughly flat, allowing it to rise only with inflation.
Reduce military spending modestly below current levels.
Cut military spending dramatically, roughly halving the budget or more.

title: Foreign Military Intervention
question_text: How should the United States use military force abroad?

stances.text: Use US military power to actively lead and police conflicts around the world.
Intervene militarily when clear US interests or allied nations are directly threatened.

Avoid overseas military action except to defend US territory from direct attack.

title: Gun Policy
question_text: How should the government regulate firearms?

stances.text: Ban civilian firearm ownership, except for tightly licensed hunting and sport use.
Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms.
Allow all types of firearms, but require universal background checks on every sale.
Add no new restrictions, and at most loosen rules on carrying, such as honoring permits across state lines.

title: U.S. Military Aid to Israel
question_text: What level of military aid should the U.S. provide to Israel?

stances.text: Continue full military aid to Israel with no new conditions.
Continue aid to Israel, but require it to comply with humanitarian and human-rights law.
Block offensive weapons sales while continuing defensive support such as missile defense.

title: Minimum Wage
question_text: What approach should government take to the minimum wage?

stances.text: Raise the wage floor and tie it to the cost of living, so it rises automatically each year without new legislation.

Hold the wage floor at its current level and let the market set pay above it.
Remove the wage floor entirely and let employers and workers set pay by agreement.

title: Ranked-Choice Voting and Electoral Method
question_text: How should votes be cast and counted in elections?

stances.text: Replace winner-take-all elections with proportional ranked-choice voting — ranked ballots fill several seats at once, so seats reflect how everyone voted.
